dsh-trajectory-reader is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Trajectory interpretation tab: summarizes each user round — what was wanted and how the assistant fulfilled it (needs/thinking/execution/results) via a rules engine plus optional LLM narrative; files, commands and errors at a glance; user messages stay verbatim.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-45d5e14423eac85cbd15.html
